O1_Z_CAPTURE.claim: Every final post-seed-two/post-normalization competing 3-list survivor v in Y∩N(Y0) with L(v)=L'!=L0 is a member of the original source L2 set Z(L').
proof: A final 3-list survivor cannot originate in pre-branch X or X0 because adding seed vertices never increases list size.

If it originated in pre-branch Y0 and became a 3-list vertex, it acquired a new seed neighbor. Lemma 5 forbids an old-Y0 vertex outside the new seed/new Y0 from simultaneously having a new-seed neighbor and a residual-Y0 neighbor. Hence a final survivor adjacent to residual Y0 cannot originate in old Y0.

Therefore v originated in pre-branch Y with a 3-list. Since it is still a 3-list after adding y1,y2, no selected seed color that belonged to its old list was removed; thus its old and final 3-lists are the same L'.
L0 and L' are distinct 3-subsets of a 4-color set, so |L0∩L'|=2 and |L0\L'|=1.
The selected colors c1,c2 are distinct elements of L0. At least one ci lies in L'.
For every selected ci that lies in L', v must be nonadjacent to yi, otherwise adding yi with color ci would remove ci from v's list and v would have list-size at most 2.
Thus v has a nonneighbor yi in {y1,y2} with ci in L', exactly the source definition of v in Z(L').

O2_Y0_COMPONENT_UNIFORMITY.claim: For every final survivor v and every connected component C of G[Y0], v is complete or anticomplete to C.
proof: The transferred normalization output satisfies axiom (iv): no vertex outside Y0∪X0 is mixed on an edge of Y0.
A survivor v lies in Y, hence outside Y0∪X0.
If v were mixed on a connected component C of G[Y0], Lemma 1 / the elementary connected-set argument gives an edge ab of C on which v is mixed.
That contradicts axiom (iv). Therefore v is complete or anticomplete to C.

bound_components: For fixed L0 there are at most 3 competing 3-lists L'!=L0.
There are at most 2^s exact old source types T(v)⊆S.
The nonempty selected-witness mask J(v)⊆{1,2} has at most 3 possibilities.
In the source Q construction there are at most 2^(2s) ordered singleton-color type pairs and each Q_{T,T'} has support size at most 3, hence |S(Q)|<=3*2^(2s).
An exact adjacency vector from v to S(Q) therefore has at most 2^(3*2^(2s)) possibilities.
O3_COARSE_COORDINATE_BOUND.meaning: The number of coarse signatures (L(v), old type, selected-witness mask, exact stored-support adjacency profile) is bounded by B(|S|), independent of n=|V(G)|.
O3_COARSE_COORDINATE_BOUND.note: This bound is deliberately crude; only n-independence matters in B0.

O4_HARD_CORE_LOCALIZATION.claim: Any unbounded proof-distinct survivor-fiber diversity must use residual-Y0 component incidence and/or relational interactions among survivor fibers.
proof: O3 bounds every coarse coordinate by a function of seed size alone.
O2 reduces each survivor's full Y0 adjacency to a Boolean incidence vector over connected components of residual Y0; no within-component partial adjacency remains.

Therefore growth beyond the coarse bound can only arise from variation of those component-incidence vectors and/or proof-relevant relations among survivor fibers (including adjacency patterns that control P7 support implications).
No claim is made that either hard coordinate is polynomially bounded.

consequence.previous_question: How many Z-survivor fibers can coexist?
consequence.sharpened_question: Within each of B(|S|) coarse source classes, how many proof-independent Y0-component incidence / survivor-relation interface states can coexist under P7-free?
